_comment: Renames migrateMappings and fix_leftovers.py cannot work out on their own. Each entry replaces every occurrence of `old` with `new` in one file (path relative to the project root). An entry whose `old` text is no longer found is reported and skipped, so stale entries are harmless. Add an entry here whenever a regeneration needs a hand fix.

renames.why: Interface methods implemented by Entity's own getYaw(float)/getPitch(float). In the release jar they are remapped to method_5705/method_5695 along with Entity, so they must carry Entity's Mojang names.
Inside the client tick lambda, which migrateMappings skips; the receiver is one of this mod's own classes, so fix_leftovers.py cannot look it up.

Generic overrides. migrateMappings does not rename them; the typed body must keep its Yarn name because addon renderers (e.g. mechframe MechRenderer) call super.updateRenderState(...) on it. A Mojang-named override forwards to it.
